401-2530-3944-7192.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2530-3944-7192.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

147-2921-8179.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-2921-8179.description:
Cast Generous Revival by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Generous Revival.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Generous Revival, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Generous Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

512-950-3814.easyPrerequisites: Argothian Elder and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-950-3814.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands that can collectively tap to produce {W}{W}.
512-950-3814.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping the two lands.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Argothian Elder, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

1011-2292-2728-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2292-2728-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2292-2728-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 4.

3525-3755-7208.description:
Activate Pestered Wellguard by tapping it, adding {U}.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Pestered Wellguard.
Repeat.

2248-5621-7857.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

3574-4038-4613-7426.easyPrerequisites:
There is at least one +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta does not have summoning sickness.
3574-4038-4613-7426.description:
Activate Berta using Mikaeus's first activated ability by tapping them, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta's second ability triggers, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Berta using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping them, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta's second ability triggers, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Berta, you may repeat the loop using Mikaeus's last activated ability in step 1 instead, putting infinite +1/+1 counters onto creatures you control.

2034-4871-6967-7147-7817.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Paradox Shaper // Omit Variables by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Honest Rutstein.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-745-1619-6558.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-745-1619-6558.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mirrorhall Mimic and Naga Fleshcrafter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-745-1619-6558.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-3291-4460.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-3291-4460.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1563-2457-3000-7175.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1315-1850-6701.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1315-1850-6701.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

2232-2246--132.easyPrerequisites:
One of the legendary creatures must be in your hand or in the command zone, with the other being on the battlefield.
Neither legendary creature is an artifact.
2232-2246--132.description:
Cast the legendary creature in your hand by paying {0} due to Bard Class.
If Bard Class is level 3, its third ability triggers, exiling the top two cards of your library with the ability to play them until end of turn.
When the legendary creature enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the other legendary creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2232-2246--132.notes: If the legendary creature you start the combo with is in the command zone, you will need to pay for commander tax, if applicable.

224-907-4913-5310.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to draw a card and put Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Bloodghast and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Repeat.

2665-2743-6441.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating two token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

997-1429-4452-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-1429-4452-5402.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1274-2034-3188-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2034-3188-3490.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2525-5686-6132.description:
Cast Metamorphosis Fanatic by paying {4}{B}{B}.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Double.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic, creating a Blood token.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic ability, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Body Double, creating a Blood token.
Resolve the Body Double ability, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2792-6061.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
1170-2792-6061.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Cast Field of Reality by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Great Whale.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Field of Reality spell.
Activate Field of Reality by paying {1}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

49-1984-3454-4406.manaNeeded: {2}{R}{W} the first turn, with {10}{R}{R}{W}{W} available each extra turn
49-1984-3454-4406.notablePrerequisites: Sunforger attached to a creature you control.
49-1984-3454-4406.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Chance for Glory and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chance for Glory, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Chance for Glory on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Angel's Grace and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Angel's Grace, preventing you from losing the game this turn.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Angel's Grace on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your end step, Chance for Glory triggers, however you cannot lose the game due to Angel's Grace.
Repeat from step 4.

3031-5201.description:
Whenever a player would draw a card, Uba Mask exiles that card and allows the player to play that card from exile this turn.
Drannith Magistrate prevents opponents from playing nonland cards exiled by Uba Mask.
